comparison: released v0.4.0 container, vision-on production config vs identical side arm omitting --vision
finding: Text-only frees ~0.92 GiB on the 32 GiB card but the KV ceiling was already at the 131,072-token maximum, so the benefit is slack/headroom only. The native Windows 4090 lane already ships vision off. Disposition: no production config churn now; fold the text/vision profile split into the next qualified profile train where it can raise ceilings on VRAM-tight cards.
restoration: production container restarted on the unchanged vision-on config after the window
